name: Wetlands for Wildlife Grants
summary: Annual grants to restore, enhance and create wetlands and riparian areas in Colorado. Non-profit habitat groups, tribes, local governments and companies can apply; private landowners cannot apply directly.
reporting: Quarterly project updates to the CPW Wetlands Program Coordinator until completion, plus a final project report on completion.

status.quote: Applications are closed. The next round of grant applications is expected to open in February 2027.

applicant_types.quote: Local governments, other state and federal land management agencies, tribes, non-profit habitat conservation organizations, and private companies.

geography.quote: restore, enhance, and create wetlands and riparian areas in Colorado

access.quote: Check Your Eligibility Eligible Grant Recipients

window.quote: Colorado Parks and Wildlife annually seeks applications for wetland and riparian restoration, enhancement, and creation projects

reporting.quote: Each calendar quarter (March 31, June 30, September 30, and December 31) through project completion, the Project Manager must submit a project update
